Comment: A state machine to handle notifying the users via email

GetDate.$Comment: CheckCompleted returns the whole Picks-prod roster (~640 rows). Once the opp_goalie_* and lineup columns landed on that table it serialized to ~440KB, well over the 256KB state limit, so this state failed with States.DataLimitExceeded and no email was ever sent. NotifyUsers only needs to know whether picks exist -- SendEmails re-reads the day's picks itself -- so project the result down to status. Keep this ResultSelector: deleting it reintroduces the failure.
